stories.title: Weightlifting robot fails at Olympics as China pushes robotics development
new_facts: A weightlifting robot collapsed onto judges' table during WHRG competition, was stretchered off, no gold won.
Separate event, the World Robot Conference 2026 (Aug 19-23, Beijing), showcased 3,000+ robotics products.
WHRG is held in a Beijing stadium repurposed from the 2022 Winter Olympics.
Chinese AI startups are developing methods to collect training data so robots learn human skills faster.
China has over two million robots working in factories, expanding rapidly beyond humanoid showcases.
stories.line: A weightlifting robot malfunctioned at the Olympics; China is advancing robotics across industrial and consumer applications.
